name: Rho (Italy)
description: Red field charged at the centre with a yellow cog wheel (the arms of Rho).
history: Municipal flag of Rho, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by royal decree on 28 September 1933.
